facts.statement: The genus Anomalipes contains only one known species, Anomalipes zhaoi, which is known from a partial hindlimb.
facts.quote: The genus contains a single species, Anomalipes zhaoi, known from a partial hindlimb.

facts.statement: The remains of Anomalipes were discovered within a Shantungosaurus bonebed at the Kugou locality.
facts.quote: The remains of Anomalipes were discovered within a Shantungosaurus bonebed at the Kugou locality.

facts.statement: The genus name Anomalipes means "unusual foot" and refers to the peculiar shape of the dinosaur's foot.
facts.quote: The genus name Anomalipes is derived from the Latin anomalus (peculiar, abnormal, not easily classified) and pes (foot), referring to the unusual shape of its foot.

facts.statement: The specific name zhaoi honors the person Zhao Xijin.
facts.quote: The specific name, zhaoi, was named in honour of Zhao Xijin.

facts.statement: Anomalipes zhaoi lived during the Late Cretaceous Campanian stage, approximately 75 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: Anomalipes zhaoi (gr. "pie extraño de Zhao Xijin") es la única especie conocida del género extinto Anomalipes de dinosaurio terópodo cenagnátido, que vivió a finales del período Cretácico, hace 75 millones de años, en el Campaniense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: This specimen is smaller than typical caenagnathids but larger than is typical for the other main oviraptorosaurian clade, Oviraptoridae.
facts.quote: este ejemplar es más pequeño que los cenagnátidos típicos pero más grande de lo que es típico para el otro clado principal oviraptorosaurio, Oviraptoridae.

facts.statement: Anomalipes is classified within the family Caenagnathidae.
Anomalipes belongs to the infraclass Oviraptorosauria.
The time range for Anomalipes is estimated to be between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Anomalipes is an extinct genus of caenagnathid oviraptorosaurian dinosaurs known from the Late Cretaceous Wangshi Group in China.
rejected.quote: Anomalipes (meaning "unusual foot") is an extinct genus of caenagnathid oviraptorosaurian dinosaurs known from the Late Cretaceous (Campanian age) Wangshi Group of China.

rejected.statement: The holotype specimen ZCDM V0020 is an incomplete left hindlimb consisting of a partial thigh, shin, shank, a complete metatarsal III, and two toe bones.
rejected.quote: The holotype (ZCDM V0020, housed at Zhucheng Dinosaur Museum, Zhucheng, Shandong) is an incomplete left hind-limb, including a partial left thigh, shin and shank, a complete metatarsal III and two toe bones.
